title: Planned Copenhagen demonstration against the EU minimum-wage directive annulment issue
reason: The planned Jan 6 demonstration was canceled by organizers before the date after the incoming government committed to filing an EU Court case; no January gathering is documented.
notes: S005 is the opened cancellation report. S006 confirms Denmark filed the government lawsuit on 18 January; government action is not an executed demonstration.

title: FH-planned demonstration to preserve Store Bededag at Christiansborg Slotsplads
reason: The planned demonstration was scheduled for February 5, outside the January unit; the opened Jan 19 article is an announcement, not evidence of January physical activity.
notes: The article’s 300,000 figure is petition signers, not event attendees. S015 is an unopened search lead and is not used to infer turnout.

title: Paludan Quran-burning demonstration at the Dortheavej mosque
reason: The reported action concerned Paludan’s opposition to Islam and Turkey’s opposition to Sweden joining NATO, not Danish government policy; the approximately 100 people at the first site were reported as watchers, without participant-role breakdown.
notes: Site-specific record. S007 says the first demonstration began shortly after noon; S009 confirms the mosque stop. Do not count the 50 police as participants. No exact physical ending for this site is reported.

title: Paludan Quran-burning demonstration outside the Turkish Embassy
reason: The stated purpose was tied to Sweden’s NATO entry and Turkey’s position, not a demand to Denmark; no 50-plus count of participants is given for this site.
notes: S007 places this stop around 15:00 and reports counter-demonstrators without a number. S010 reports police from 14:00 and “some people” with a Soundbox trying to drown Paludan out. Treat that counter-action separately only if later evidence establishes a distinct assembly and its size/target.

title: Paludan Quran-burning demonstration at the Russian consulate
reason: The reported demonstration was part of Paludan’s three-site action and stated foreign-policy/religious grievances, not a demand to the Danish government; no participant count is reported for this site.
notes: S007 retrospectively confirms the third site occurred. S010’s earlier-in-the-afternoon page only announced a planned 16:00 stop; the planned time is not used as the actual start/end time.

title: Possible counter-demonstration using a Soundbox outside the Turkish Embassy
reason: The account says some people tried to drown Paludan out, but does not establish a distinct assembly with 50 participants or a demand addressed to Danish government/policy.
notes: Retained as a separate discovery lead rather than merged with Paludan’s act. “Some people” is not a participant estimate and no exact count is inferred.
